answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fakery. Each epoch, five random auditors inspect recent work; each, like a raven, carries one sealed verdict. One whisper of doubt triggers a deeper check by three more peers. Passing audits lifts the agent toward the summit of a trust ladder; failing burns a 12-token deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 12,000 tokens against 400 in rewards, a 30-to-1 loss; an honest agent pays 12 once and keeps its reward stream.
